protocol_status: Derived from archived evaluator source and final result JSON files; not reexecuted for release
weights: Checkpoint EMA with strict model.load_state_dict after removing a leading module. prefix
image_scale: Native image resolution; no full-image resizing during final evaluation

input.padding: Reflect-pad bottom and right to multiples of stride 512, then crop predictions back to the original image extent

inference.tta: Tile-local D4: rotations by 0, 90, 180, 270 degrees, each with and without horizontal reflection; invert each transform on its prediction
inference.precision: torch.autocast(cuda, torch.bfloat16) in the archived inference implementation; probabilities cast to float32 for accumulation
inference.merge: Equal-weight arithmetic average of probabilities across all overlapping tiles and all eight transforms
inference.distribution: Disjoint strided image subsets per GPU, with summed validation histograms and test counts reduced across ranks

ground_truth.mask_conversion: Read unchanged, convert RGB masks to grayscale when needed, then road = raw > 127
ground_truth.alignment: Crop prediction and mask to their common minimum height and width from the top-left corner

threshold_selection.tie_break: First maximum returned by numpy.argmax, selecting the lowest tied threshold
threshold_selection.test_application: Freeze the selected validation threshold; predict road where probability >= threshold
threshold_selection.also_reported: Fixed threshold 0.5 using the same checkpoint and predictions

metrics.primary_aggregation: Sum TP, FP and FN across all pixels of all test images before calculating precision, recall, F1 and IoU (pooled/micro)
metrics.mean_image_f1: Arithmetic mean of separately calculated per-image F1; this is an additional metric, not the pooled F1

training_validation_distinction: Checkpoint selection uses deterministic center crops at the training crop size with threshold 0.5. The validation metrics in final metrics.json instead use native-image sliding windows, D4 TTA and validation threshold tuning.
